church.subtitle: Who We Are
church.title: A family of believers
church.intro: Loyalty House International is a Christian denomination under the Lighthouse Group of Churches. We are a Bible-believing, Christ-centered church committed to loving God, serving His people, and sharing the Gospel with the world. Everyone is welcomed, valued, and encouraged to discover God’s purpose for their life.

pillars.heading: Our Mission
pillars.summary: We preach the Gospel, plant churches, train pastors, and strengthen the Body of Christ.
items: Preach the Gospel of Jesus Christ

pillars.heading: Our Vision
pillars.summary: A strong, growing, mission-minded church where people encounter God and become disciples.
items: Encounter God and His transforming power
Grow through the Word of God
Use their gifts in His service
Spread the Gospel near and far

pillars.heading: What We Believe
pillars.summary: The Bible is the inspired Word of God and the foundation of our faith. Salvation is found through faith in Jesus Christ.
items: The ministry of the Holy Spirit

serve.heading: Missions & Church Planting
serve.body: The Great Commission is central to our calling. We reach people through crusades, missions, and planting churches — then establish them as mature disciples.

serve.heading: Training Pastors & Leaders
serve.body: We identify, train, and equip pastors and Christian leaders through biblical instruction, mentoring, discipleship, and practical ministry.

serve.heading: Our Church Family
serve.body: Loyalty House is more than a place of worship. Whether you are beginning in faith or looking for a place to serve, there is a place for you here.

church.connection: As a denomination under the Lighthouse Group of Churches, we share a global vision of evangelism, discipleship, church planting, and raising leaders — a wider family reaching nations for Jesus Christ.

convention.subtitle: The Homecoming
convention.title: A gathering on the mountain
convention.history: The Homecoming Convention began as a gathering of believers returning to the mountain — a place of encounter, worship, and renewal. Each year, thousands from across the globe come together at Anagkazo Campus in Mampong, Ghana.

cards.heading: Purpose
cards.body: To gather God’s people for worship, teaching, fellowship, and spiritual impartation under the ministry of Dag Heward-Mills.

cards.heading: Vision
cards.body: A global homecoming where nations are represented, lives are transformed, and the presence of God is experienced on the mountain.

cards.heading: Impact
cards.body: Past conventions have seen attendees from dozens of nations, powerful testimonies, and lasting ministry connections formed across continents.

firstLady.subtitle: A Word of Welcome
firstLady.title: Welcome home
firstLady.name: Lady Rev. Adelaide Heward-Mills
firstLady.message:
Dear Beloved Church Family,

With great joy, Bishop Dag and I warmly welcome you to our Homecoming Convention 2026!!

What a wonderful privilege it is to gather once again as one family in Christ. To think that our brothers and sisters are coming from over 100 countries,  across every continent of the world, fills my heart with gratitude to God. Look how far the Lord has brought us! Truly, only the Lord could build such a beautiful family, united by His love and His purpose.

Whether this is your very first Homecoming or you have attended many before, I pray that from the moment you arrive you will feel at home. Homecoming is more than a convention—it is a joyful reunion. It is a time to worship together, learn together, pray together, and rejoice in all that the Lord has done among us. It is also an opportunity to strengthen old friendships, make new ones, celebrate the wonderful work God is doing through His Church around the world, and most importantly, sit at the feet of our father and Bishop for a fresh word from the Lord.

My prayer is that these days will be a time of refreshing for you. May the Lord speak to your heart, strengthen your faith, renew your vision, and fill you with fresh oil as you spend time in His presence. I also pray that you will leave with precious memories, lasting friendships, and a deeper love for the Lord Jesus Christ.

As you make your journey here, remember that your presence will be a  blessing, and we that we are truly looking forward to spending these special days together as one church family.

For those local to Accra, and the various regions of Ghana, welcome!
And for those making the journey by bus, train or plane, welcome!

On behalf of Bishop Dag, our family, and the entire Homecoming team, I say, welcome home!

May the Lord richly bless you.
With much love,

Lady Rev. Adelaide Heward-Mills
